vuln_statements.explanation: The nft_pipapo_walk() function handles concurrent iteration over nftables pipapo set elements. Based on the evidence, this function has potential race conditions between UPDATE and UPDATE_CLONE paths when accessing shared match/clone pointers without proper synchronization. The vulnerability stems from missing synchronization mechanisms when multiple threads access these shared data structures concurrently.
